ceu: ✦ The trine between the Sun and Mars

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: If you have an agreement to make, put everything in writing.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Go to bed half an hour earlier than usual.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Spend half an hour on a hobby just for the pleasure of it.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Put a plant or fresh flowers in your home.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, routine and money: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, money and your career: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Ask yourself what you are afraid of losing, and why.
